cover_headline: Immigration Court Memo Cuts Key Filing Deadlines to 10 Days
facts: EOIR Policy Memorandum 27-02, effective November 23, cuts the deadline to file written pleadings and evidence on removability to 10 days, down from about a month
Applications for relief or protection are now due 10 days after a judge sustains the charges of removability, down from 60 days
If an application or document is not filed within the time the judge sets, the opportunity to file it is deemed waived

end.headline: Immigration Court Memo Cuts Key Filing Deadlines to 10 Days
end.line: EOIR's Policy Memorandum 27-02, effective November 23, replaces month-long and 60-day filing windows with 10-day deadlines for represented respondents in removal cases.
